course_title: Communication and Technical Writing Skills in English
description: This course covers writing technical documentation for software development, including API documentation using Javadoc and Doxygen; creating user manuals for mobile apps using Markdown and Sphinx; drafting technical reports following IEEE standards; designing communication strategies for cybersecurity incidents using the NIST Cybersecurity Framework; and developing presentations using Microsoft PowerPoint with technical content. Students will also learn to write clear and concise technical emails, use version control with Git for collaborative writing, and create technical white papers following ACM standards.

clos.text: Define technical writing standards such as IEEE and ACM for different types of documents.
Describe the structure and components of API documentation using Javadoc and Doxygen.
Explain the principles of technical communication in cybersecurity incident response using the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
Apply technical writing techniques to create user manuals for mobile applications using Markdown and Sphinx.
Implement a technical white paper following ACM standards and using Git for version control.

topics: Introduction to technical writing in IT contexts
Documenting APIs with Javadoc and Doxygen
Creating user manuals with Markdown and Sphinx

labs: Communication strategy design for cyber incidents
White paper development following ACM standards

topics: Technical writing for software development lifecycle
Technical writing for cloud and distributed systems
Ethics and standards in technical communication
